entities.name: Bohumila Grögerová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bohumila Grögerová was a Czech poet, experimental poet and translator. She translated more than 180 writings from French and German in collaboration with her professional and life partner, Czech poet Josef Hiršal, who died in 2003. She also authored children's books and radio plays.

entities.summary: Bohumila Grögerová was a Czech poet, experimental poet and translator. She translated more than 180 writings from French and German in collaboration with her professional and life partner, Czech poet Josef Hiršal, who died in 2003. She also authored children's books and radio plays.
